method.stage_walls: t126-post-t123-phase-split/summary.json (instrumented attribution, one pass per cell, never a wall claim)
method.kernel_parity: t70-clipper-candidate/FINDINGS.md (Rust vs C++ Clipper2 twin, 295-case corpus)
method.canonical_work_set: source reading at the pin; file+function citations in canonical_citations.json

shapes.name: overhang quartile polygon bands replaced by canonical per-vertex distance
shapes.note: The whole stage wall is the ceiling; the replacement (per-vertex AABB distance at emit) costs something, so the net is lower. 85.4% of the stage is three whole-layer round offsets per band layer (t84), and 4,859 clips over 485 band layers; canonical has no band polygons and no per-layer overhang-speed clips.

shapes.name: whole-mesh facet classification / overhang footprint union replaced by canonical per-layer overhang polygons
shapes.canonical_counterpart: PrintObject::detect_overhangs_for_lift (supports-off) and TreeSupport::detect_overhangs (supports-on); no whole-mesh facet pass
shapes.note: After t76 the 326,546-facet overhang union is partitioned; the stage is 4.26 s on base-off. facet_classes/bridge_regions/surface_groups have no production reader outside the needs_support predicate and visual debug; canonical computes per-layer overhang polygons instead.

shapes.name: seam-planning per-region inset offset deleted; canonical projects onto the printed loop
shapes.canonical_counterpart: SeamPlacer::init / gather_seam_candidates / calculate_overhangs_and_layer_embedding / align_seam_points (no region-boundary offset anywhere in SeamPlacer.cpp)
shapes.note: 92.4% of the stage is one serial native offset per region (t84), 495 calls on base-off; the ceiling applies that share. Canonical does seam planning at G-code export, with per-vertex distances and loop projection, and no inset polygon.

shapes.name: ShellClassification horizontal shadow cascade deleted / vertical-shell path substituted
shapes.kind: work-set (two-way; canonical runs discover_vertical_shells and process_external_surfaces instead)
shapes.canonical_counterpart: PrintObject::detect_surfaces_type + PrintObject::discover_vertical_shells; PrintObject::discover_horizontal_shells early-outs at the default ensure_vertical_shell_thickness = evstAll
shapes.ceiling_ms: unpriced; the non-gate shell work was 10,136 ms on base classic supports-off in the t75 pre-t123 probe, and Pass 2 is a subset of that
shapes.note: Canonical does not run the shrinking-shadow cascade at the matched settings, so PnP's Pass 2 is extra work; but canonical adds discover_vertical_shells and the process_external_surfaces wave expansion, which PnP omits (DEV-200). A work-set port is a swap, not a pure deletion.

shapes.name: internal-bridge whole-layer offsets clipped to the candidate surface bbox
shapes.canonical_counterpart: PrintObject::bridge_over_infill (clip_clipper_polygons_with_subject_bbox at the candidate and limiting-area intersections; cached boundary_by_spacing)
shapes.ceiling_ms: unpriced; the two whole-layer offsets were 21,423 ms of the 27,429 ms serial phase B on base supports-off before t75, and t75 parallelised them
shapes.note: Both engines do whole-layer offsets here, but canonical bbox-clips every downstream intersection and caches the per-spacing boundary; PnP's per-surface qualification still intersects whole-layer clip areas. This is a locality shape, not a deletion.

shapes.name: planner occupancy inflation served from a radius/layer collision cache
shapes.pnp_producer: modules/core-modules/tree-support-planner inflate_model_occupancy (uncached host::offset_polygons at the per-layer emit check and the per-origin role carve)
shapes.canonical_counterpart: TreeSupportData::calculate_collision / calculate_avoidance (tbb::concurrent_unordered_map keyed by {radius, layer, recursions}; one offset_ex + expolygons_simplify per distinct radius, reused by every node)
shapes.note: t113 measured occupancy at 433 + 431 calls (32.7 s) on base-on; t125 batched the calls but did not reduce their count and the wall gate failed 6/8. A canonical-style cache removes duplicate work rather than only parallelising it. This is the largest supports-on shape and is unmeasured as a cache.

route.prepass_only_verdict: Wins base classic-off only (0.787x); loses base classic-on (1.012x, a tie), benchy classic-off (1.053x) and benchy classic-on (1.075x).
route.full_geometry_parity_verdict: Wins all four (0.335x / 0.661x / 0.550x / 0.704x) because PnP's fast import is kept and the whole geometry phase reaches canonical cost.
route.consequence: The destination is a full engine-parity program, not a prepass work-set port. On the benchy cells the per-layer phase is not a last-mile afterthought: with the prepass at canonical cost it is 1,450 / 1,644 ms against an Orca wall of 1,716 / 2,462 ms.
